about.title: ABOUT ME
about.subtitle: Creative professional with a passion for designing and building modern web experiences.
about.description: I'm Anushka, a CS student passionate about creating clean, bold, and dynamic web interfaces. I balance code efficiency with artistic visuals to construct websites that engage users immediately and leave a lasting impression.
about.objective: To secure a challenging software engineering or UI/UX role in a forward-thinking team where I can apply my web development expertise, user-centered design systems, and rapid prototyping skills to build products that scale.

services.title: UI/UX Design
services.description: Designing intuitive, high-fidelity wireframes, interactive user flows, and modern design systems that match current branding standards.

services.title: Web Development
services.description: Building responsive, highly performant single page applications using React, Next.js, and utility-first styling libraries like Tailwind CSS.

services.title: Branding
services.description: Creating unique visual identities, logo marks, consistent typographic styling, and color structures that elevate visual storytelling.

services.title: Problem Solving

approachSteps.title: Understand
approachSteps.description: I research the problem, analyze user requirements, gather assets, and outline the software constraints.

approachSteps.title: Design
approachSteps.description: I sketch layouts, create interactive high-fidelity Figma prototypes, and establish the visual style guide.

approachSteps.title: Develop
approachSteps.description: I write clean, modular React/TypeScript code, configure Tailwind variables, and test component functionality.

approachSteps.title: Launch
approachSteps.description: I deploy the web application to high-speed staging environments, run SEO checkups, and publish the release.
